verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents enterprise identity authentication (SSO, SAML, OIDC, SCIM) or signing in through a cloud platform account. Related items do not qualify: Outposts covers where sessions run, the VPN covers network reach, and create_as_user_id covers API impersonation; none of these is identity-provider authentication.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability
